recent_excerpts: Chrome's Enhanced Protection now runs server-side Gemini scam detection and flags ClickFix clipboard payloads before users paste malicious PowerShell commands.
iRhythm says a June social engineering attack exposed names, insurance numbers, and device serials for 360,000 patients across Texas, South Carolina, and California.
NCSC, FBI and AIVD warn that Iranian state actors use CHOSEN BRICK malware, delivered via WhatsApp and Telegram social engineering, to spy on dissidents and journalists.
